title: Canonical tower pullback and tensor reassociation

from.place: Steps 1–2, the actual whole-tower composition and Cartesian source/counit words before realization

statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, the ordinary strict coefficient-tower derived categories, tensor and section-normalized geometric pullbacks $(b,o)$ of [def-sp-tower-shriek-data], with their inverse-image compositor from [def-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-interfaces]. Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ and $h:X\to Z$ be quasi-compact compactifiable morphisms of Noetherian schemes, presented by open/proper factorizations $f=p_f\circ j_f$, $g=p_g\circ j_g$, $h=p_h\circ j_h$, and a specified equality $gf=h$. For $K\in D(Z)$, $M\in D(Y)$ and $N\in D(X)$, define towerReassociate to be the canonical isomorphism
$$h^*K\otimes(f^*M\otimes N)\xrightarrow{\sim}f^*(g^*K\otimes M)\otimes N.$$
It is, in order, transport along $gf=h$ followed by the inverse of the specified inverse-image compositor on $K$, the inverse tensor associator, and the inverse tensor-pullback comparison for $f$ on $(g^*K,M)$, tensored with the identity of $N$. The tensor is ordinary derived tensor on strict varying-coefficient systems, not completed tensor. This records the existing towerReassociate definition, without asserting any purity composition equation or choosing a new comparison.
